question: How does this approach compares to the state-of-the-art results on these tasks?
title: Contextual Joint Factor Acoustic Embeddings
answer_short: The proposed approaches outperform the VAE baseline, with CJFA showing significant gains of up to 3% on phone classification and 3–6% on speaker recognition.
answer_rationale: Text 3 and Text 4 state that the CJFA encoder performs significantly better than the VAE baseline in both phone classification and speaker recognition tasks, with relative improvements of up to 3% on phone classification and 3–6% on speaker recognition. Text 9 also confirms that one of the proposed approaches outperforms phone classification baselines, achieving 74.1% accuracy, which is higher than the VAE baseline's 72.0% accuracy mentioned in Text 2.
